The panel is leaning against a wall, with visible mounting brackets and wires attached to the frame.
The surface of the panel appears clean and intact, with no obvious cracks or damage.
The background includes a pink wall and a tiled floor, suggesting an outdoor or semi-outdoor setting.
There is a watermark or text overlay on the image, partially obscuring the view of the panel.

risks.proof: A close-up photo of the panel's surface under bright light, showing the cells from multiple angles, and a photo of the backside with connectors and junction box.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or with reduced efficiency

risks.risk: The panel may not be genuine or may be a counterfeit, especially since the watermark obscures the view.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the label or nameplate on the back of the panel, showing the brand, model, and wattage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified authenticity, which may reduce value

risks.risk: The panel may be used or refurbished, with hidden wear or degradation in performance.

risks.if_unproven: priced as used or refurbished, which reduces value

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the label or nameplate on the back of the panel showing brand, model, and wattage.
Clear, close-up photo of the panel's surface under bright light to check for microcracks or damage.
Photo of the backside showing connectors, junction box, and any damage or wear.
Video or photo of the panel under sunlight with a multimeter reading to verify output.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
